author: PokerFace
body:
I don't know if there is an in-game message already but, if you want a bigger community, you are going to need more people on the forums. Just advertise the forums in-game and players will register. When the tournament comes, especially advertise this and the community will grow on the forums and perhaps in-game. Thanks. Try to spread
the word. 

"You have to work for success"

Keep in mind this is something anybody can do. 

-PokerFace
